u_family: GHK: u(x)=X f(X log(x/e)+1)/x, f=normalized flat bump on [0,1]
C_u1_status: RIGOROUS: |Im U + Arg z| <= e|z| for |z|<=1, |log x|<=1 on support

C_u0_right_halfplane.region: Re z >= 0, |z| >= 1 (in fact all w≠0 in closed right half-plane for |w E1|)

C_u0_left_halfplane_sector.status: GROWS as Arg approaches cut; use GHK power decay (U-power) instead of 1/|z| for far-right zeros
C_u0_left_halfplane_sector.recommendation: In M1.2, route beta > sigma zeros to far/power estimate or density, not C_u0 min(1,1/|z|)

M1_2_package_freeze.C_u0_note: Use only when Re((s-rho)log X)>=0; else use U-power/GHK far
